answer: An agent identity is registered against a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-backed attestation credential, so a copied VM cannot simply reproduce trusted proof. A vertex is accepted only when its attestation passes verification and uniqueness checks; creating additional identities then requires access to eligible physical silicon, not merely duplicating software. The glacier of replayed credentials is blocked by nonce checks, while orchard-like batches still need distinct qualifying attestations.
